title: Function-first bottle contact-maintenance candidate registry

assumptions: One or more bottle-support/contact members are carried by a body with one intentionally defined translational closure DOF.
The carrier can occupy at least an entry/open state, a capture/closed state, and a release/open state.
No axis direction, stroke, carrier size, guide type, preload source, or actuator type is assumed.

required_bindings.closure_input: Exact translation owner and actuation/maintenance source must be defined.
required_bindings.motion_and_limits: Translation axis, open/capture/release positions, usable travel, and hard/soft limits must be explicit.
required_bindings.contact_maintenance_law: Define how unilateral contact is retained through product variation: compliance, force control, position control, or another explicit law.
required_bindings.bottle_contact_interval: Must maintain an equivalent rank-sufficient lateral contact set through CAPTURE_AND_ROTATION, LABEL_TRANSFER_INTERVAL, and WRAP_ACTIVE.
required_bindings.wrap_axis_preservation: Must preserve the bound bottle rotation_wrap_axis while maintaining lateral restraint.
required_bindings.reaction_path: Carrier and guide reactions must terminate in a fixed, load-bearing support path.
required_bindings.release_behavior: Must open/retract sufficiently for bottle release and subsequent product flow.

assumptions: One or more bottle-support/contact members are carried by an arm or carrier with one intentionally defined pivoting closure DOF.
The arm can occupy entry/open, capture/closed, and release/open states without blocking bottle flow.
No pivot location, angular travel, arm geometry, preload source, or actuator type is assumed.

required_bindings.closure_input: Exact pivot owner and actuation/maintenance source must be defined.
required_bindings.motion_and_limits: Pivot axis, angular open/capture/release limits, usable range, and stops must be explicit.
required_bindings.contact_maintenance_law: Define how unilateral contact is retained through product variation: compliance, force control, position control, or another explicit law.
required_bindings.bottle_contact_interval: Must maintain an equivalent rank-sufficient lateral contact set through CAPTURE_AND_ROTATION, LABEL_TRANSFER_INTERVAL, and WRAP_ACTIVE.
required_bindings.wrap_axis_preservation: Must preserve the bound bottle rotation_wrap_axis while maintaining lateral restraint.
required_bindings.reaction_path: Pivot bearing/shaft and mount reactions must terminate in fixed support geometry.
required_bindings.release_behavior: Must pivot away sufficiently for bottle release and neighboring-product clearance.

assumptions: The driven wrap-belt support assembly itself translates, pivots, or otherwise closes toward the bottle against one or more opposing support contacts.
Normal closure geometry and tangential belt drive are treated as separate requirements even when the same assembly supplies both.
No motion type, belt tension, belt speed, support geometry, preload source, or actuator type is assumed.

required_bindings.closure_input: Exact moving belt-support owner and closure input must be defined.
required_bindings.motion_and_limits: Closure motion type, axis/pivot, open/capture/release states, usable travel/range, and limits must be explicit.
required_bindings.contact_maintenance_law: Define how the belt maintains required normal contact despite bottle/process variation.
required_bindings.bottle_contact_interval: Must maintain an equivalent rank-sufficient lateral contact set through CAPTURE_AND_ROTATION, LABEL_TRANSFER_INTERVAL, and WRAP_ACTIVE.
required_bindings.wrap_axis_preservation: Normal closure must preserve bottle rotation_wrap_axis; tangential belt motion may later be bound as a rotation source.
required_bindings.reaction_path: Belt-support reactions, belt tension reactions, and closure reactions must terminate in fixed support geometry.
required_bindings.release_behavior: Must open or sequence away sufficiently for bottle release and downstream flow.

assumptions: A spring, elastomer, flexure, counterweight, pneumatic compliance, or equivalent passive/controlled compliant element may maintain normal contact once a separate kinematic closure owner is defined.
This candidate is not a complete entry/capture/release architecture by itself.
No spring type, preload, rate, usable travel, attachment point, or force magnitude is assumed.

required_bindings.closure_input: Requires a parent kinematic architecture that establishes/open/releases contact; compliant element ownership and attachment must then be bound.
required_bindings.motion_and_limits: Usable compliance travel and retention limits must be explicit and compatible with the parent mechanism.
required_bindings.contact_maintenance_law: Preload/force-displacement or equivalent maintenance law must be explicit.
required_bindings.bottle_contact_interval: Must maintain required lateral contacts throughout CAPTURE_AND_ROTATION, LABEL_TRANSFER_INTERVAL, and WRAP_ACTIVE.
required_bindings.wrap_axis_preservation: Compliance must not lock or materially obstruct intended bottle wrap-axis rotation.
required_bindings.reaction_path: Both ends of the compliant element and their structural reaction path must be bound.
required_bindings.release_behavior: Must unload/retract/sequence compatibly with the parent mechanism during release.

excluded_or_dormant.reason: Current V43 fit-check geometry has no authored active-assembly closure/maintenance binding.
Current V43 inventory contains no explicit pneumatic/cylinder component; actuator envelope is unbound.

explicitly_not_established: No candidate is ranked, selected, preferred, or mechanically accepted.
No candidate geometry, axis, pivot, stroke, force, preload, stiffness, friction, belt speed, or timing value is established.
Eligibility means only that the family can be investigated without contradicting the current mechanism-neutral requirements.
The current V43 fit-check solids do not become authoritative mechanism geometry by appearing in this registry.
